sources.title: Meridian Water moves into next phase with major works underway
sources.verified_claim: Enfield reported Strategic Infrastructure Works opening more than 30 acres for over 1,500 homes and 400,000 sq ft of business space, with roads, bridges, parks and connectivity works intended to support accelerated delivery from 2026.

sources.title: Enfield Design Review Panel
sources.verified_claim: Enfield states regeneration including Meridian Water will transform parts of the borough and that the Design Review Panel advises on placemaking, urban design and sustainability as a material consideration in planning decisions.

sources.title: Flood protection boost for Enfield with more than £1 million funding for projects
sources.verified_claim: Enfield secured more than £1 million for 2026/27 flood-alleviation projects, confirming active climate-resilience investment; this is borough-level context and not parcel-specific flood status.

sources.title: The Beam Parkway Linear Park
sources.verified_claim: Havering says the Beam Parkway project aims to improve walking, cycling, green space and connections, but TfL funding had not been confirmed and the Council was investigating other funding options.

sources.title: January's Cabinet Meeting to Review Key Business Plans
sources.verified_claim: Havering reported Cabinet review of regeneration business plans covering about 6,000 homes and associated schools, open space, health, commercial and community infrastructure.

sources.title: Beam Park planning conditions P0242.21
sources.publisher: London Borough of Havering planning portal
sources.verified_claim: Condition 75 limits residential occupations until the on-site Beam Park Station is constructed and available to passengers, showing an explicit transport-dependent delivery constraint.

sources.title: Regeneration activity in Lambeth
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's live regeneration portfolio identifies multiple growth locations including Brixton, Waterloo and Vauxhall and describes regeneration as social, economic and physical place improvement.
